steps.en: Install into your chosen agent and start a new session
steps.zh: 装入所选助手，再开新会话

steps.en: Ask for an object and its action, with optional colors and facing
steps.zh: 描述物件及动作，可指定配色和朝向
steps.code: /fun-isometric a pen scribbling on a square pad

steps.en: Guides the agent to draw layers and rig them with motion presets
steps.zh: 指导助手分层绘图，绑定动作预设

steps.en: Guides checks and contact-sheet review before handing over icon code
steps.zh: 指导检查和拼帧预览，再交付图标代码

steps.en: Approve the look and embed an icon in your application
steps.zh: 批准外观，把图标嵌入应用

steps.en: Plays the layered drawing on canvas with your palette and motion settings
steps.zh: 按你的配色和动作设置，在画布播放分层图形

value.en: Get an editable animated sticker, not a still image or a hand-built frame loop
value.zh: 得到可修改的动态贴纸，不再只拿静态图或手写帧循环
